narrative: Edith's mended sleeve on the parlour table, the new seam finer than the old. No face. No hand in the square. The doublet's shoulder goes out of the frame. You are not in the picture.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Stood at the table. Not pictured.

entities.name: Edith Kettlewood
entities.context: Her work is the sleeve. Her face is not in the picture.
